headline: Congress extends the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom so it can keep operating through fiscal year 2026.
what_it_does: This law renews the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF) through fiscal year 2026, which ends September 30, 2026. USCIRF is an independent federal commission. It tracks threats to religious freedom in other countries, reviews U.S. government policies on the issue, and makes policy recommendations.

who_it_affects.group: The U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom and its staff
who_it_affects.how: The commission is authorized to keep operating through fiscal year 2026 instead of expiring.

who_it_affects.group: Federal officials who set U.S. foreign policy
who_it_affects.how: They will keep receiving the commission's reviews and recommendations on international religious freedom.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted September 30, 2024; the commission is reauthorized through fiscal year 2026.
